ANTHROPIC MATHEMATICIAN SAYS AI HAS SOLVED THE MOST FAMOUS PROBLEM IN MATH
articles.summary: An Anthropic researcher claims he worked with AI to discover a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis. The conjecture in number theory predicts how primes are distributed. Mathematicians have been trying to crack it for 167 years, without success. The researcher's proof passed verification with proof-checking software.

articles.title: TESLA LAUNCHES FSD V15, TARGETS ITS BIGGEST WEAKNESSES, FROM SIGNS TO POTHOLES
articles.summary: The release notes for Tesla's Full Self-Driving v15 read like a list of the feature's biggest current weaknesses. The update includes improvements to sign detection, potholes, and speed handling in school zones. It also adds an impressive-looking live visualization. FSD can now slow down for speed cameras. The update is currently being rolled out.

articles.title: THE MERGE
articles.summary: Neuralink has increased the rate of surgeries and extended its clinical trials to Canada and the UK. The first participants in the company's studies now hold video chats with new participants to coach them on how to adjust to the technology. The terms of their trials don't include the option for upgrades. Unless Neuralink comes up with a commercial device, they will have to return to their pre-cyborg lives.

articles.title: AI X BIO IS NOT _JUST_ A DATA PROBLEM
articles.summary: How far AI gets in biology will depend largely on how much data we have. It will also depend on what is measured and the quality of that data. An abundance of systematically incomplete measurements is unlikely to lead to a comprehensive understanding of many of the complex systems that occur in biology. AI will likely become a powerful tool that will contribute to the study of biology, but there is still no clear path to documenting a comprehensive account of how a whole cell or tissue works.

I DON'T EXPECT SUPERINTELLIGENCE IN 2027
articles.summary: The industry seems to have a preference towards believing in extremely short timelines. We are probably about 60% of the way towards superintelligence relative to where we were in 2022. Superintelligence will likely arrive in 2029 rather than in 2027. While this seems like a tiny difference, it changes what the industry should prioritize. The current push towards deprioritizing 'long-timeline' work is not a good idea.

articles.title: THE ALICE HUANG ASSOCIATE ACCUSED OF FUNNELING NVIDIA CHIPS TO CHINA
articles.summary: Li Ming, a 52-year-old Chinese national, was reportedly a central operator of a web of companies that smuggled restricted Nvidia AI chips to China. The web included Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company led by Alice Huang, with whom Jensen Huang had an affair. Li is currently out on bail in Singapore, living in a luxury villa down the street from the Chinese embassy. Li was charged with fraud in February 2025 in a case tied to the alleged transshipment of Nvidia chips. His criminal case is ongoing.
